question: Which of the following metals is NOT used for manufacturing of piston bearing?
solution:
The correct answer is __Cast iron**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lead__, __Copper__, and __Silicon__ are commonly used in the manufacturing of piston bearings due to their properties like lubrication, strength, and wear resistance.
 
• __Cast iron__ is not suitable for piston bearings as it lacks the necessary properties such as high wear resistance and lubrication for the purpose.
 
• Piston bearings are critical components in engines, requiring materials that can handle high stress and reduce friction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lead:**

 
 
• Lead is used in bearings due to its excellent self-lubricating properties and softness, which aids in reducing wear.
 
 
 
• **Copper:**
 
 
• Copper-based alloys are commonly used in piston bearings due to their high thermal conductivity and strength.
 
 
 
• **Silicon:**
 
 
• Silicon is often added to aluminum alloys used in engine components to improve wear resistance and strength.
